# Alpenglow Software

> Alpenglow Software LLC makes small-business apps for Shopify and monday.com. Positioning: "Your back office, handled." The apps save time, filter out noise, and catch costly mistakes. They find, flag and recommend; the person using them makes the final call. Free and paid plans available.

Support: support@alpenglowsoftware.com. Privacy policies and terms for every app: https://legal.alpenglowsoftware.com/

## Save time (monday.com apps)

- [PostroomIQ](https://alpenglowsoftware.com/monday/postroomiq/): turns orders, invoices and leads forwarded to an email address, and their attachments, into monday.com board items with AI, and sends anything uncertain to review.

## Filter the noise (Shopify apps)

- [ClearSignal](https://alpenglowsoftware.com/shopify/clearsignal/): sorts Shopify store sessions into real shoppers, good AI agents, bad bots and unclassified, shows the conversion rate with bad bot and AI agent sessions taken out, and shows where bot traffic comes from by country and data center. It measures; it doesn't block visitors.
- [FraudPilot](https://alpenglowsoftware.com/shopify/fraudpilot/): puts the orders Shopify flags as medium or high risk in one review queue with the reasons, can hold new risky orders until you approve them (optional, paid plan), and keeps a log of your decisions. It never cancels orders or blocks checkouts.

## Catch costly mistakes (Shopify apps)

- [GhostCode](https://alpenglowsoftware.com/shopify/ghostcode/): audits a Shopify theme for leftover code from uninstalled apps, apps that still load through script tags (which Shopify ends on March 1, 2027), app speed cost and known malicious scripts. It only reads the theme and never edits it.
